tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 13. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - two defects measured on the LIVE v108 line during Ankit's phone test, both with gateway ground truth on record: DEFECT A, fabricated offer times: after establishing Tuesday 08/18 offers, the ask 'What about Monday that week?' extracted the literal 'monday next week' (losing the anaphor to the 18th's week), and the follow-up 'What is the earliest I can do that day?' produced spoken offers of 'Monday 08/10/2026 09:00 am or 09:15 am' - times that DO NOT EXIST (real 08/10 inventory starts 11:15 am). The final slot variables held 08/05 values, so the response LLM composed offer copy that ignored the slot templates entirely. DEFECT B, anaphoric week reference: 'Monday that week' must mean Monday of the already-discussed week (Mon 08/17 for the week of Tue 08/18), not 'monday next week'. THE GATEWAY IS BEING EXTENDED IN PARALLEL (lane 44): it will parse 'monday next week', 'monday the week of 08/18/2026' (and '...the week of the 18th'), 'friday this week', and will return a new availability result field from_unresolved (true when from/to text was present but unparseable). Build against that contract. SOURCES (copy into CWD, then edit): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD15/gl-round12-fix/ has the round-12 draft (minted v108), validator (assertions 1-12), build scripts, frozen-extractors.json, fixtures. THE FIX, exactly: (1) EXTRACTION ANAPHORA: extend ONLY the preference_from and preference_to descriptions in frozen-extractors.json (user_verbatim/day_part/time_after stay byte-identical): when the patient references a day relative to an already-discussed or already-offered date or week - forms like 'monday that week', 'the monday of that week', 'monday the same week' - resolve the reference against that established date and emit the EXPLICIT form 'monday the week of MM/DD/YYYY' using the established date; include the canonical example: with Tuesday 08/18/2026 offers standing, 'What about Monday that week?' extracts 'monday the week of 08/18/2026'. Apply the identical updated pair on every user-wait feeder (n_goal_ask, n_goal_response, n_mixed_intent, n_date_conflict, n_date_conflict_retry, n_gate_1, n_gate_2 - wherever the frozen set lives today). (2) OFFER-INTEGRITY CONTAINMENT: add to the n_goal_response prompt a hard rule paragraph beginning with the exact marker 'OFFER-INTEGRITY:' stating: every clock time or date spoken in an offer must be one of the literal rendered slot values ({{slot_1_day_name}} {{slot_1_start}} / {{slot_2_day_name}} {{slot_2_start}}); if the current slot values do not answer what the patient asked, never state any other time or date - instead say what the available slot values are or ask for the patient's preference. Keep the prompt at most 4,100 characters. (3) FROM-UNRESOLVED HONESTY: add responseData mapping from_unresolved from $.result.from_unresolved to every availability webhook; in the n_goal_ask prompt (and the n_goal_response miss handling if present) treat from_unresolved true as: do not trust or speak the returned slots; ask the patient plainly for the day. n_goal_ask prompt stays at most 2,200 characters. (4) Everything else unchanged. (5) VALIDATOR: add ASSERTION 13 keeping 1-12 intact: the preference descriptions carry the anaphoric-week rule ('that week' and 'week of' phrasing present); the n_goal_response prompt contains the OFFER-INTEGRITY marker; every availability webhook maps from_unresolved. Structured FAIL citing 'assertion 13'; must PASS your draft and FAIL the untouched round-12 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD15/gl-round12-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json with an assertion citation. (6) build_goalloop.py regenerates deterministically; fixture-conformant.json updated. (7) DEBUG.md: both live defects with the ground-truth evidence, the changes, regeneration command.
